identity.description: Front (front.com / frontapp.com): shared inbox and customer communication platform for teams; Core API at api2.frontapp.com, developer portal at dev.frontapp.com.
identity.identity_notes: Front's developer docs describe the Front Platform (shared inbox / conversations, teammates, channels). Assignment hint front.com is consistent with official docs at dev.frontapp.com and help.front.com.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code grant only; authorize at https://app.frontapp.com/oauth/authorize, token at https://app.frontapp.com/oauth/token; access token expires in 60 minutes, refresh token in 6 months.
auth.token_refresh: Refresh via POST to token endpoint with grant_type=refresh_token; refresh token valid 6 months, rotated in last 24 hours of window.
auth.scopes_notes: API tokens: admin selects features, namespaces, and per-resource permissions (read, write, delete, send). OAuth scopes not retrieved.

access.production_restrictions: Public integrations must use OAuth; OAuth is required for public integrations available to all Front customers unless the vendor grants an exception. Apps can be published to all Front customers or kept private to one instance. API tokens must be created by a Front admin.

read_ops: List/get across accounts, channels, conversations, contacts, inboxes, tags, teammates, teams, views, rules, statuses, events, knowledge bases, custom fields, analytics
write_ops: Create/update/delete accounts, channels, contacts, conversations, drafts, messages (create/reply/import), comments, tags, inboxes, links, views, shifts, signatures, teammate groups, time off, knowledge bases
api.rate_limits: unknown (Rate limiting page at dev.frontapp.com/docs/rate-limiting not retrieved)
api.limitations: Rate limits page exists but content was not retrievable; rate limits reportedly vary by plan (third-party blog only, unverified). Attachments are download-only. Some resources are deprecated (Contact Groups). MCP server feature is not available for API tokens.
